messages:
alex: heads up — canary rollout for runtime v3.7.1 is on hold. observed ~25% token/sec drop on continuous-batcher across us-west-2 canaries. attaching quick stats.

build-bot: PERF ALERT: ctb-regression-suite failed on main@f7a2c3. token_rate median -28% (p95 -33%). CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/p/12345

maya: ugh. did we change the kernel selection heuristic in that release? kernel-autoselect PR (f7a2c3) went in last night.

sam: yes, that PR adds a new affinity scoring that prefers fp16-fused kernels for medium seq lengths. suspect mismatch when kv cache warmup patterns hit. kv hitrate on canary dropped from 0.82 -> 0.54

hao: small profiler snippet from canary (top hot paths):
```
0.34s  memcpy_gpu
0.27s  kernel_fp16_fused
0.12s  scheduler_prefetch
0.09s  kv_cache_lookup (miss path)
```
Looks like extra memcpy + misses are amplifying queueing delays.

maya: do we have batch size distribution? I'm seeing more small batches (avg tokens/batch down 18%). that leads to higher per-token overhead on the new kernel.

sam: run bisect: `git bisect start bad f7a2c3 good e9d8b1` — repro locally with ctb-sim harness. I'll run, any other hypotheses?

build-bot: CI flamegraphs: https://ci.redwood.example/artifacts/f7a2c3/flame.svg (note large memcpy wedge vs baseline)

alex: if it's kernel affinity causing underfilled batches + kv misses, we might need a fast rollback. can we isolate to a single commit for revert? also block the rollout to remaining regions.

hao: bisect found commit f7a2c3 as first bad. Reproducer: `./dev/tools/ctb-run --seed=42 --seq-dist=longtail --kv-warmup=staggered` shows token/sec drop locally.

maya: propose temporary revert: revert PR #4123 (kernel-autoselect) and re-run canaries. I'll file the rollback PR.

sam: +1. also opening an issue to harden kernel selection: add a KV-hit-aware scoring term and prefer less memcpy heavy codepaths when batch occupancy is low.

opsbot: action items created: ROLLBACK-312 (revert kernel-autoselect), BIS-308 (bisect notes + reproducer), BLOCKROLL-55 (canary hold) :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks team. once rollback is in canaries let's watch token/sec and kv hitrate for 2 hours before re-promote. :thumbsup:
